sections.name: File setup, StorageModule
sections.title: Storage module and queue wiring
sections.what: Groups storage, the queue service, and the document processor into one shared module. It also sets up the document-processing queue with three tries and growing waits, keeping finished jobs.
sections.why: Likely reason: the module is global so the rest of the app can use file storage without setup in each place.
sections.watch_out: The same retry settings appear in the queue service as well, so update both if the retry policy changes.

summary: Groups the storage service, the job queue service, and the document processor into one module that the rest of the app can use.
purpose: Makes file storage and background document processing available across the whole app and sets up the document-processing queue.
why: Likely reason: the module is marked Global, so other parts of the app can use storage without importing it each time.
how: 1. Imports the HTTP client module and the Bull queue module. 2. Registers the document-processing queue with three tries, growing waits, and finished jobs kept. 3. Lists the three services as providers. 4. Exports the storage service, queue service, and Bull module for other parts of the app.
inputs: No direct inputs. The services it loads read settings from the config service and connect to the queue storage configured elsewhere.
outputs: A registered module that provides the storage and processing services to the app.
risks: Retry settings are written here and again in the queue service, so changing one may not change the other. The document processor starts with the module, so any process that loads this module also runs document jobs. The connection to the queue storage is not configured in this file.
debug: If a service says the document-processing queue is missing, check that the queue module is set up in the app root. If processing never starts, confirm this module is loaded and the processor is registered.
